headline: SAP hits $14.3 billion quarterly revenue milestone, lifts 2026 outlook
summary: SAP reported $14.3 billion in quarterly revenue, driven by a 26% increase in cloud revenue, prompting the company to raise its 2026 outlook.
why: SAP is a global enterprise software giant whose cloud migration trends and artificial intelligence adoption serve as key indicators for enterprise technology spending.

impacts.name: SAP
impacts.why: Strong cloud revenue growth and upwardly revised guidance signal robust business demand for enterprise software.

why_moved: Beating revenue expectations and raising full-year guidance typically drives institutional buying and upward stock revaluation.
